title: Complete Staging actions baseline contract before ordered migrations

phases.objective: Make the canonical baseline actions table satisfy the full ordered migration contract and fail closed before disposable SQL execution when required columns are absent.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The generator runs from an exact clean main checkout with explicit BUILD_STAGING_SCHEMA_BUNDLE confirmation.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The disposable MariaDB can replay migration 022 and the remaining ordered chain without unknown actions columns, while the generated bundles remain three-role, schema-only, and readback governed.
steps: Read the role manifest required_actions_baseline_columns contract.
Validate every required actions column in the canonical schema.sql before starting disposable MariaDB.
Apply the baseline and ordered migrations only after the preflight passes.
Verify actions metadata, schema-import fields, and SQL-only auth-reference fields remain available to later migrations.
Keep Production access, provider access, data export, secrets, and mutation false.
Require live Staging certification before any Activation or cross-environment promotion decision.
assertions: migration 022 does not fail on action_title, action_id, endpoint_group, or route_target.
The baseline actions table includes the metadata, authorization-reference, OpenAPI-reference, and schema-import columns required by the migration chain.
The generator reports required_actions_baseline_columns in plan evidence and blocks closed when the contract is incomplete.
The schema bundle remains exact-SHA, disposable-MariaDB, three-role, schema-only, and canonical-seed governed.
No Production migration, grant, deployment, provider mutation, DNS mutation, or secret handling is introduced.
